$comment: Resolved values per theme (aliases flattened). Source of truth: project/tokens.json.

usage.surface: Workspace ground: warm off-white in light, deep navy in dark (never pure white or black). Behind maps, diagrams and tables.
usage.surface-raised: Panels, cards, drawers, the mission composer.
usage.surface-sunken: Wells: map ground, code/data blocks, inactive tracks.
usage.line: Decorative hairlines and dividers between panels. Never the only border of a control.
usage.line-strong: Input and control borders, chart axes (3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes).
usage.ink: Primary text and numbers on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every -soft tint.
usage.ink-muted: Secondary text, metadata, units, axis labels on any surface.
usage.ink-subtle: Placeholders and tertiary labels on surface and surface-raised only (4.5:1); disabled text.
usage.saffron: PRIMARY brand accent as a FILL: primary button, active stage, selected scenario, selected site. Text on it is on-saffron. Max one saffron fill per view region.
usage.saffron-strong: Saffron as a stroke or mark (3:1): active flow path, opportunity series in charts, focused node outline, the mark's tail.
usage.saffron-ink: Saffron as text: opportunity values and labels on surfaces and saffron-soft.
usage.saffron-soft: Tint behind opportunity tags and the current stage.
usage.on-saffron: Text and icons on a saffron fill (6.9:1 light, 8.5:1 dark). Never white.
usage.ashoka: Brand navy as a large fill: app icon tile, brand moments, cover slab. Text on it is on-ashoka.
usage.on-ashoka: Text and marks on ashoka and nav-surface.
usage.nav-muted: Inactive nav labels and icons on nav-surface.
usage.blue: SYSTEM / INTELLIGENCE: links, info states, system data series, network links on maps, AI-activity indicators. As text on surfaces and blue-soft.
usage.blue-2: Secondary system series and reference connectors (3:1 on surfaces). Pair with blue, never alone as text.
usage.blue-soft: Tint behind system tags, info banners, selected table rows.
usage.green: POSITIVE / SUSTAINABLE only: recovered waste, reduced emissions, saved water, viable circular path, validated completion. Text on surfaces and green-soft. Never decoration.
usage.green-soft: Tint behind positive tags and discovered circularity nodes.
usage.on-green: Text and icons on a green fill.
usage.amber: ASSUMPTION / UNCERTAINTY: assumption tags, dashed assumption bands, attention states. Text on surfaces and amber-soft. Always with the ≈ glyph or a dashed border so it is never confused with saffron.
usage.amber-soft: Tint behind assumption tags and attention banners.
usage.red: ENVIRONMENTAL RISK / FAILURE / CRITICAL CONSTRAINT: risk tags, increases in emissions or water, errors. Text on surfaces and red-soft. Always with ▲ or ! and a word.
usage.red-soft: Tint behind risk tags and error banners.
usage.grey: Unavailable, inactive, unknown, baseline. Never carries meaning on its own.
usage.focus: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (10:1 light, 7:1 dark on surface-raised).
usage.link: Inline links. Underlined on hover and always in body copy.
usage.viz-opportunity: Chart series: economic opportunity, selected scenario.
usage.viz-system: Chart series: system and reference data (primary).
usage.viz-positive: Chart series: environmental improvement, recovered value.
usage.viz-risk: Chart series: degradation, risk, increase of a harmful quantity.
usage.viz-assumption: Chart overlays: assumption bands and ranges (always dashed).
usage.scene-ground: 3D scenes: the top of every plinth (map, ecosystem, factory floor).
usage.scene-plinth: 3D scenes: plinth sides — the slab that makes a scene read as a model, not a screenshot.
usage.scene-building: 3D scenes: building and machine bodies (white-model architecture).
usage.scene-roof: 3D scenes: roofs, stacked goods, secondary volumes.
usage.scene-machine: 3D scenes: steel — pylons, machine heads, chimneys.
usage.scene-field: 3D scenes: agricultural land (raw materials). Never green — green is earned.
usage.flow-material: Flow grammar: material and product moving (bale-shaped packets).
usage.flow-energy: Flow grammar: grid electricity (pulse packets along conduits).
usage.flow-renewable: Flow grammar: renewable electricity — green because it is a sustainability gain.
usage.flow-water: Flow grammar: water in, recovered water back (drop packets). The only resource-specific hue; 3:1 on surface and scene-ground in both themes.
usage.flow-waste: Flow grammar: waste leaving a process, before any value is found.
usage.flow-circular: Flow grammar: a VALIDATED circular pathway (waste → value). Only after discovery.
usage.ai: AI discovery layer: the system's own markers, construction feed, analysing states.
usage.simulated: SIMULATED values and ghosts — always dashed or hatched, always tagged SIM; CURRENT stays solid ink.

font.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif

display.usage: Brand moments only: the Command Center title, the cover, slide titles.

metric-xl.usage: Headline industrial metrics (capacity, tonnes recovered, ₹ crore). Tabular figures.

metric.usage: Values inside metric tiles, table totals.

data.usage: Coordinates, IDs, formulas in the Evidence Drawer, evidence kind labels.
